```{r kg-setup, include=FALSE}
# rna_03_key_genes_report.Rmd
# HTML report generated by rna_03.1_key_genes.R via rmarkdown::render();
# uses the variables of that script (RECEPTOR, CELL_LINE, OUT_PREFIX...) and reads
# tables and figures from results/<RECEPTOR>/<CELL_LINE>/. Not run on its own.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,
                      fig.align="center", dpi=150)
library(dplyr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

fmt_tbl <- function(df, caption=NULL)
  df |> mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) |>
  kable(caption=caption) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options=c("striped","hover","condensed"), full_width=FALSE)

res_dir  <- RESULTS_DIR
fig_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "figures")
tab_dir  <- file.path(res_dir, "tables")
sig_file <- paste0(RECEPTOR, "_resistance_signature_conservative.csv")
sig      <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, sig_file), check.names=FALSE)
```

## Resistance signature

```{r sig-summary}
data.frame(
  Version    = c("Conservative"),
  N_genes    = nrow(sig),
  Upregulated   = sum(sig$Classification == "Upregulated"),
  Downregulated = sum(sig$Classification == "Downregulated"),
  Forced     = sum(sig$Forced)
) |> fmt_tbl("Signature summary")
```

**Filter:** genes with |LFC| ≥ `r LOGFC_THRESHOLD` + Mean_Expr_Par > −5 (removes floor-effect artifacts). `r if (any(sig$Forced)) "Forced genes shown below regardless of LFC." else "No forced genes for this dataset."`

```{r forced-genes, eval=any(sig$Forced)}
sig |> filter(Forced) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene, LFC_Res_vs_Par, Classification) |>
  fmt_tbl("Forced genes")
```

## Known genes detected

```{r known, eval=any(c("In_gimenez_common","In_gimenez_egfr","In_gimenez_group2","In_met_core","In_egfr_core") %in% colnames(sig))}
known_cols <- intersect(c("In_met_core","In_gimenez_common","In_gimenez_egfr","In_gimenez_group2","In_egfr_core"),
                        colnames(sig))
sig |> filter(if_any(all_of(known_cols))) |>
  dplyr::select(Gene, LFC_Res_vs_Par, Classification, all_of(known_cols)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(LFC_Res_vs_Par))) |>
  fmt_tbl("Genes from reference lists")
```
